title: Colonial Mexico City replaces Tenochtitlan
summary: Spanish conquerors destroyed Tenochtitlan and built colonial Mexico City over its remains in the sixteenth century. Surviving structures and the surrounding lake landscape preserve traces of successive urban worlds.
